report.owner_safe_summary: The Launchroom project demonstrates strong technical foundations with a valid release payload, live GitHub repository, successful Fivetran partner integration (both account probe and connector management API access confirmed), and all public submission surfaces verified as live. The Vertex AI Agent Builder deployment configuration is present and correctly declares 7 tools, indicating readiness for cloud deployment. The agent also successfully executed a 7-tool function-calling loop using the Gemini API. However, critical blockers remain, including the absence of a 3-minute narrated demo video and the need for a GCP project ID to enable a live Google Cloud deployment. Addressing these two items is essential to achieve a higher readiness score and ensure a complete submission.
